senses.def: A derivative of colchicine where a nitrogen-attached acetyl group is replaced by a formyl group, and also has an additional methyl group. IUPAC name N-methyl-N-[(7S)-1,2,3,10-tetramethoxy-9-oxo-6,7-dihydro-5H-benzo[a]heptalen-7-yl]formamide

forms_of: information and related forms of that word
